data.action: 坐在落地窗前的轮椅上侧身回眸，夜色与微光交织
data.description: 五星级酒店落地窗前俯瞰着城市璀璨夜色，蕾缪安穿着松开的西装与长裤坐在轮椅上侧身回眸，夜色与头顶光环交织成梦幻的光晕。她轻咬朱唇低语——「今夜的巡逻与职责已经全部结束了……抱我到床上去吧，我的指挥官。」
data.nsfwProse: Her tailored hotel trouser suit jacket hangs open with her shirt unbuttoned at the collar, revealing her bare collarbone and soft cleavage above matching loose trousers.
data.promptProse: Beside the panoramic window of a darkened luxury hotel suite overlooking glittering night city lights, Lemuen sits in her wheelchair wearing her tailored trouser suit with the jacket open and blouse unbuttoned over her collarbone. Turning back over her shoulder with a soft blush and lightly bitten lip, she meets the viewer's gaze as distant skyline lights and her warm halo rim her profile in the quiet dark room.
data.title: 蕾缪安 · 旅店夜装
data.animaCaption: Seated in her wheelchair by the panoramic hotel window with her tailored suit jacket open and collar unbuttoned, Lemuen looks back over her shoulder with a soft blush and parted lips. Distant night city lights and her glowing halo outline her profile.
